resources.string: No saved bills yet.\nCalculate and save a bill to see it here.
The saved bill for %1$s will be removed. This cannot be undone.

1. Choose the month.
2. Enter the units used (1 to 1000 kWh).
3. Slide to set the rebate (0% to 5%).
4. Tap Calculate to see the bill, then Save to keep it.
Electricity Bill Estimator calculates a monthly electricity bill from the units used (kWh) and a rebate, using block rates. Bills are stored offline on your device.

First 200 kWh: 21.8 sen/kWh
Next 100 kWh (201 - 300): 33.4 sen/kWh
Next 300 kWh (301 - 600): 51.6 sen/kWh
601 kWh onwards (up to 1000): 54.6 sen/kWh

1. On the home page, choose the month.
2. Type the electricity units used (1 to 1000 kWh).
3. Move the slider to choose the rebate (0% to 5%).
4. Tap CALCULATE to see the total charges and the final cost after rebate.
5. Tap SAVE to store the bill. Saving a month that already exists updates it.
6. Tap the history icon or VIEW SAVED BILLS to see the list of months with their final cost.
7. Tap a month to see its details. Use EDIT to change it or DELETE to remove it.
8. Tap the info icon on the home page to open this About page.
